Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email 3. Enter valid password 4. Click Login
Expected Result: User is taken to the dashboard

Title: Login with wrong password
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email 3. Enter wrong password 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message: Invalid email or password

Title: Login with unregistered email
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter unregistered email 3. Enter any password 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message: Invalid email or password

Title: Login with empty fields
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Leave both fields empty 3. Click Login

Title: Login with empty password
Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Leave password empty 3. Click Login

Title: Email format validation
Steps: 1. Enter abc.com as email 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Invalid email format message is shown

Title: Password is hidden
Steps: 1. Type a password in the password field

Title: Show password toggle
Steps: 1. Type a password 2. Click the eye icon

Title: Account lock after failed attempts
Expected Result: Account is locked or captcha appears

Title: SQL injection attempt
Steps: 1. Enter ' OR 1=1 -- in email field 2. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails and no error details are exposed
